issues.description: The problem statement requires the IDs of all Radwege (task 10), but the solution selects Radweg_zu_Gemeinde.name instead of an identifier column. This contradicts the exercise requirement and will mislead students or fail tests that expect IDs.
issues.suggestedFix: Modify the solution (and ensure the template hints) to select the Radweg identifier column instead of the name. For example: SELECT Radweg_zu_Gemeinde.radweg_id FROM Radweg_zu_Gemeinde, Gemeinde WHERE Gemeinde.schluessel = Radweg_zu_Gemeinde.gemeindeschluessel AND (Gemeinde.regierungsbezirk = 'Oberfranken' OR Gemeinde.regierungsbezirk = 'Unterfranken'). Use the actual ID column name in the schema (e.g. radweg_id or id).
